questions.question: How does God portray Israel in Hosea 2?
options: An unfaithful wife who chased other lovers
A widow mourning in the streets
A queen ruling over many nations
A faithful bride wholly devoted to her husband
questions.answer: An unfaithful wife who chased other lovers

questions.question: What does God promise to do despite Israel's unfaithfulness in Hosea 2?
options: Cast her off entirely and send her away into exile
Wait patiently until she had earned back all his favor
Allure her and betroth her to himself forever
Hand her over completely to all of her many lovers
questions.answer: Allure her and betroth her to himself forever

questions.question: God promises to betroth Israel to himself in righteousness, justice, steadfast love, and mercy.
I will _____ her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.
I will say to Not My People, 'You are my people'; and he shall say, 'You are my _____.'
